main_text.p: מלט Ithpeh. אִתְמְלַט Ch. Eripi, liberari, evadere, eruere, liberare se, Prov.19.5.

מלך Ch.Regnare, ut Hebr. Deinde Ch. & Syr. Consultare, consilium inire, consilium capere, consilium dare, cosulere: Item Syr. Promittere, polliceri, ad Rom.1.2. & 4.21. ad Eph.6.2. Aphel אַמְלֵךְ Regnare, regnare facere, regno praeficere, regem constituere. Item Consultare, Futur. אַמְלִיךְ בְּנַפְשִׁי Consultabo mecum, Cant.6.11. דִּי אַמְלִכְנֵיהּ לִבֵּיהּ Qui consilium inivit in corde suo, Esth.7.5. Pahel מַלֵּךְ Consulere, Jobi 26.3. Ithpahel אִתְמַלֵּךְ Ch. & Syr. Consultare, consilium inire vel capere; Ithpeh. אִתְמְלֵךְ Idem: Syriac. Promitti, Praet. ܡܠܟܬ Promissa est promisio ad Gal.3.16.
מַלְכָּא, מַלְכִּין, Ch. & Syr. Rex, Plur. מַלְכַיָּא, מַלְכִין, Syr. ܡܠܟܐ, Reges: Foem. מַלְכְּתָא Regina. Plur. מַלְכָתָא, מַלְכָן.
מַלְכוּ, מַלְכוּת, מַלְכוּתָא Ch. & Syr. Regnum. Plural. מַלְכָן, מַלְכוּתָא.
מְלִיכָא, מָלִיךְ Ch. Consultus, consiliarius, 2. Sam.15.12.

מַלְכָא, מַלְכָּא, מַלְכָּ Ch. ܡܠܟܢ Syr. Consilium, consultatio. ܡܠܟܢ ܟܘܠ Consiliarius, ad Rom. 11.34. Plur. מַלְכִין, מַלְכָת & masc. מַלְכִין Cōsilia: sic cū Aff. דִּרְבִּרְבִין מַלְכוּתִי Cujus magna sunt consilia, Jer.32.19.
מַלְכְּנָא, מַלְכְּנָא Ch. Idem. Syris vero ܡܠܟܢ est Promisio, Promissum.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew words are reproduced as far as legible; the Syriac forms in the middle of the page are only approximately rendered. The printed Syriac words are set in the cut type shown on the scan and could not be read letter by letter in every case.
